question: Can the finite-k completed-U1 scalar constraints be packaged as an executable preferred-source algebraic projector that returns B, phi, psi and physical Newtonian potentials without integrating chi as an independent state, and round-trip exactly through shadow-v3 after a consistent source-coordinate transformation?

scope.modes: finite k>0; exact k=0 routed separately
scope.inputs: preferred-coordinate fundamental source snapshot deltaH0, deltaH0_prime, delta_mu, q, delta_p, Pi plus background derivatives
scope.outputs: psi, psi_prime, phi, B, Phi_N, Psi_N and constraint/denominator diagnostics

acceptance: implement the preferred A -> Hamiltonian -> momentum solve ordering directly with no B_prime input
use native CLASS stress normalization and the same K, a1_eff, Pcal, alpha1 conventions as shadow-v3
construct Phi_N=(1-Pcal)phi+psi+alpha1 L psi-H B-3a^2 Pi and Psi_N=psi-H B
return preferred A, Hamiltonian and momentum residuals and reject exact k=0

in a deterministic conservation-consistent self-test, transform the projected preferred state to Newtonian sources using an arbitrary B_prime and verify shadow-v3 reproduces phi, psi, B_prime, Phi_N and Psi_N with max absolute error <2e-13
verify all preferred constraint residuals <1e-13 and source roundtrip <1e-14
do not import, patch or modify production CLASS
next_if_pass: derive a physical early-time preferred-source adiabatic seed/series and feed it into this projector; only then design the opt-in Boltzmann DAE bridge.
non_claims: not a physical adiabatic initial-condition derivation
